A sports series which feels like it has been running since the dawn of gaming, Madden NFL has been ongoing for over thirty years. Madden NFL has steadily been releasing one new game every year for as many consoles as possible since 1988. On occasions, the series does deviate from this lucrative plans, releasing mobile versions, or a unique version of its game for the Nintendo 64 in 1997. The result is 44 unique games, despite the franchise being only thirty years old.

The longest-running videogame series has existed for 51 years 145 days, and was achieved by The Oregon Trail, from its first release in 1971 to the latest in 2023.

The Oregon Trail was originally developed by Don Rawitsch, Bill Heinemann, and Paul Dillenberger as an educational, text-adventure game to teach school children about the realities of 19th Century pioneer life on the Oregon Trail. For the past 50 years, the game's concept has been iterated on and turned into graphically rich choose-your-own adventure style games. The latest iteration - The Oregon Trail: Boom Town - is a a free-to-play Farmville-like mobile game.

content.text:
**The Oregon Trail**

According to Guinness World Records, The Oregon Trail is the longest-running video game franchise, having existed for over 51 years from its first release in 1971 to the latest iteration in 2023. It was originally developed by Don Rawitsch, Bill Heinemann, and Paul Dillenberger as an educational text-adventure game.
